assertions: Task9K7PXS ports native ScPatternAttr FillToEditItemSet/FillEditItemSet,GetFromEditItemSet,FillEditParaItems and GetCellOrientation. Original input snapshots are read before target Changed hooks,and forward/reverse insertion order is preserved. Three independent script fonts,absolute height conversion using genuine integral o3tl rounding,complex color/underline payloads,conditional/table/direct precedence and parent SET handling are preserved. Original asymmetries remain:automatic color clears direct EditEngine color,table style participates in family/height/weight/color but not posture/line/language,script spacing is forced off,and reverse left adjustment leaves existing cell alignment(CALC239). The real shared SfxItemSet const-reference PutAsTargetWhich clones for the destination pool and adopts the remapped clone without changing its source. No fake EditEngine pool,layout service,formatted-number provider or document state is added. Render/number/hash caches are absent in this data slice;no fake invalidation hook is supplied. Actual EditEngine/GetNeededSize/GetOptimalHeight and automatic wrapped-height remain required and unported. Full native UI/device/font/UNO/ABI parity remains unverified.
